content:
![](/post-images/mainbhishaayar-img1-D-ebmLc2.jpg)

**Ghar se kabhi nikle the kabhi** sapne lekar kayin,

Basaane ke ek nayaa jahaan, pata nahi kaise rh gaye yahin..

Par issi ummeed par jee rahe hain aaj bhi,

Ki manzil to milegi hi, bhatak kar hi sahi.. 😊😊

[#viditkestatusseinspired](/blog/hashtags/viditkestatusseinspired)

[#serious](/blog/hashtags/serious)

 

Zindagi ki aadat hai sawaalon mein uljhaana..

Humaari, muskuraana..😊

Out of syllabus bolkar aage badh jaana.. 😎😋

 

**Kayin baar** jab hum baht kuch khna chahte hain..

Par jise khna hai..

Wo samjhe naa samjhe..

Aage humaare baare mein kya soche..

Iss khayaal se hi chup rh jaate hain..

Meri maano to kh do..

Samajhdaar log sab samajh jaate hain..

Aur kh dene se kaafi masle hal ho jaate hain..

 

**Kuch aisa ho ....**

Ki aankhon mein sapne to hazaaron hon..

Par nigaahe dil sirf uss ek aashiyaane par

Kuch aisa ho....

Ki kadam to humesha zameen par rahein..

Par haunsalein rahein sirf aasmaanon par..

 

**Wo pal**, beshak ek pal se bhi kam mein guzar gaya

Par wo ehsaas, ek inaayat ki tarah, umr bhar ke liye ..
